meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: Claude 会检查 claude-mem 的云同步状态，或按 cmem.ai→Connect 给出的三个值（token、user id、SyncHub URL）写入本地设置、重启 worker 并验证连通，最后报告设备 ID、待推送数量和错误，全程不打印 token。
howto.when: 当你说「设置云同步」「同步我的记忆」「同步状态」等，或想把记忆数据库备份到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置云同步，token、user id 和 Hub URL 我马上给你
say.note: 写入三个连接值并重启 worker

say.text: 重启 worker 再验证一次同步
say.note: 重启后每 5 秒轮询状态，最多 30 秒

howto.what_en: Claude checks your claude-mem cloud sync status, or writes the three cmem.ai → Connect values (token, user id, SyncHub URL), restarts the worker and verifies it. Reports device id, pending counts and errors; never prints the token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "sync status" and similar, or want your memory database backed up to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync; I'll give you the token, user id and Hub URL
say_en.note: Writes the three values and restarts the worker

say_en.text: Restart the worker and verify sync again
say_en.note: Polls status every 5s for up to 30s
